Confirm the legal copyright holder, content rights, paid-app agreement, banking, tax, and regional trader/compliance information.
Publish HTTPS privacy-policy and support pages with real contact information, then place their final URLs in metadata.json and App Store Connect.
Complete and attest the current App Store age-rating questionnaire against the final merged combat, commerce, and user-generated-content behavior.
Capture final-build gameplay on supported iPhone and iPad sizes, review every localized frame, and upload one to ten opaque screenshots per required display class.

Create every product currently present in content/ios-iap-catalog.json, configure the subscription group and localized prices, approve agreements, and verify purchase, restore, refund, expiry, and offline states in Sandbox and TestFlight.
Upload a signed archive, finish export-compliance answers, run device and TestFlight regression, and record acceptance evidence for save restoration, purchases, safe areas, iPhone, and iPad.
Confirm privacy labels against the final binary and third-party SDK report, select the approved build, choose release timing and availability, and explicitly submit it for App Review.
